items.text: Service and cadre are two separate decisions, and both matter.
Judge each service by the life and autonomy it permits, not only status.

blocks.heading: Avoid When You Fill Your DAF

items.text: IAS field postings, IPS law-and-order duty, and IFS embassy life are very different jobs day to day.
A home cadre is not automatically the right call, and a different-state cadre is not automatically a downgrade.

Allocation is by rank against your submitted preference order, but reserved-category vacancies, prior-cycle carryovers, and how higher-ranked candidates ordered their own preferences all shift the exact cutoff every year.

blocks.heading: Career Options After UPSC CSE
rows: General category, CSE 2025 cycle. Moves up or down each year with vacancies and category-wise reservation.
Closes after IAS in almost every cycle, since most toppers list IAS first on the DAF.
A candidate who prefers IPS over IAS is allotted IPS even with a rank high enough to claim IAS.
IRS and other Group A central services
Exact cutoffs shift every year by category and vacancy count; check the official rank list before assuming.

blocks.heading: Career Path Inside the IPS
rows: District posting under a Superintendent, hands-on training in field policing and investigation.
Runs a full district police force, the first major independent command.
Links state headquarters to district forces, advises SPs on complex investigations, oversees specialised units.
Commands a zone made up of several ranges, or heads a specialised department.
State-level command of a specialised wing such as crime branch, intelligence, or training.
Heads a state's entire police force. Only one per state, decided by seniority, empanelment, and government selection, not automatic promotion.

blocks.heading: Other Group a Central Services
rows: Entry grade after training, first independent charge of tax assessment or enforcement work.
Wider jurisdiction, more complex cases, first real management responsibility.
Oversees multiple assessment units or a specialised investigation wing.
Senior regional charge, appellate and policy-implementation work.
Heads a full commissionerate; a major administrative and revenue-target milestone.
Top field and policy positions, feeding into Central Board of Direct Taxes or Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs roles.

items.text: Officers can be deputed to bodies like the World Bank, International Monetary Fund, Asian Development Bank, or United Nations agencies, usually after around 9 years of service, sometimes earlier in exceptional cases.
Most IFS officers become a head of mission somewhere between 24 and 30 years of service.
